videos.script_preview: Instead of manually exporting database tables to analyze them with AI, you can now let local agents query and chart your SQL databases directly. DataZen does this by running a built-in Model Context Protocol, or MCP, server inside a local-first desktop client. To generate a daily sales report, you safely connect your local database using AES-encrypted OS keychain credentials. DataZen's built-in MCP server exposes your schemas and EXPLAIN analyses directly to external agents like Claude or Cursor. videos.title: AI Video in 3 Seconds: MiniMax H3 Max Workflow
videos.script_preview: Instead of waiting minutes for an AI video render, a new model generates playable shots in three seconds. MiniMax H3 Max on fal.ai turns text prompts or reference images into 768p clips faster than real-time. You type a shot description, click generate, and the rendered clip begins playback almost instantly. For video editors, this shifts AI generation from slow batch queuing into live, interactive shot prototyping. videos.title: Stop Saving Mac Screenshots to Your Desktop
videos.script_preview: If you're constantly blurring API keys, dragging arrows, and recording separate video guides for your team, your Mac's default screenshot tool is wasting your time. A new free utility called Seenshot consolidates this entire workflow into a single keyboard shortcut. Imagine you're a developer sending a bug report. Press Command-Shift-2, select the buggy UI, and use the native editor to instantly blur sensitive user data.
